The '''Guardian E2''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] included with [[Guardian 5e Personal Defense Speeder]] and produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It served as an emergency escape vehicle.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
